note: X50 Ultra (G0111): the stock X50 settings tree (newsettings settings_tree_product_dianapro = res/k0.json; dianamax rF.json is byte-identical) and the stock X50 game menu (xhplayer BaseConfigKt.getDianaConfigListV2), mapped in devices/g0111/research/X50_MENU_D.md. Eye protection: off / follow / be at ease (stock more_eye_state). No fit-now action, no fit-to-screen page, no rotation, no colour temperature, motion smoothing, AI contrast, super resolution, aspect ratio, sound enhancement, equalizer, leveling, launcher choice in this port; no projector settings or CEC page (the X50 has no Lumen screen for them: the old X50 menu stays only as the menu over the eye-protection cover). Level angles while the keystone page is open (the stock angle dialog calls); sleep timer and remote pairing are pages of the app. Light source level 1..10 (DisplayManager 6/7, boost read 152) only on this model (owner decision t20); no Boost step: the boost setter 151 is not allowed, a Boost set in stock stays and the slider refuses. Dynamic black (172/174) on this model only, never in the PC, office or HDR Vivid picture mode. Game menu (adapter apps/X50Projector/src/org/lumen/projector/panel/X50GameIo.java, stock calls with file and line in devices/g0111/research/X50_GAME_CALLS.md): speed and HFR on DisplayManager 76 / 77; VRR, game picture, dark scenes, super resolution, game sound and the frame counter on GmTvManager 145..150 / 120..122, GmAudioManager 75 / 76 and DisplayManager 179, each new call gated (its getter answered in range this boot first, every write read back, a disagreeing read-back closes the item); game sound offers off / surround / story (the stock clarity and balance are not in the module); aspect ratio left out (its stock path goes through XgimiService, not traced); none of these items is laser related, so the Ultra Max has the same list. Eye-protection safety stays in X50EyeGuard; the menu only sends the stock user-row calls.
